requirements_summary: Technical: maintain p95 latency <250ms for support agent workflows; sustain token throughput spikes to 2M/day with autoscaling; logical routing to fallback lower-capacity model for non-critical routes. Ops: Dedicated VPC peering, KMS integration, SSO/SAML, audit logs exported to SIEM. Commercial: 12-month contract with staged ramp (30% -> 70% -> 100%), committed GPU-hour baseline, explicit burst pool for product launches, transparent overage rate (prefer $/M tokens).
pricing_conversation_summary: Main negotiation points: commit level (baseline 120 GPU-hours/mo preferred), burst credit pool (one-time 20% of commit available for spikes), overage rate (asked for $8/1M tokens equivalent; currently quoted $12/1M tokens), ramp schedule concessions (first 3 months ramp with pro-rated commit), early-termination terms (want limited liability for 60-day opt-out if SLA misses), and discount: asking 18-25% off list for 12-month commit. Jordan pushed for a pilot credit (one month) to offset migration costs. Finance asked for committed ARR banding and quarterly invoicing. SEs provided kernel-level perf notes to justify lower pricing on predictable workloads.
poc_results: POC highlights: latency stable at p50 80ms, p95 210ms on dedicated-like staging; reranking throughput matched expectations (0.9M tokens/day steady, short bursts to 1.4M). Memory/KV cache warm-up showed 15% token-cost improvement after persistent caching. Observability: Redwood Console traces instrumented; token-level cost breakdown shown to their finance lead. Issues: initial cold-start on midday spikes caused 10-15% p95 blips; SE recommended pre-warmed worker pool for launch windows.
recommended_pitch_points: Offer a 3-month ramp schedule with pro-rated commit and one-month complimentary burst credit
Provide a capped overage rate table (tiered) to remove billing unpredictability
Include a dedicated onboarding credit and 60-day SLA exit clause contingent on repeated SLA misses
Highlight cost savings from caching + Optimize recommendations (showed 15% improvement in POC)
Confirm VPC/KMS integration timeline and show sample DPA clauses to speed legal review
